moments.title: UK Half Term & Halloween Build-Up
moments.blurb: October half-term is approaching for most of the UK, with many Halloween events already in full swing or starting soon.

angles.name: General UK
angles.copy: Half-term is just around the corner for much of the UK, and the spooky season is officially upon us! How are you planning to celebrate Halloween this year?

angles.name: Family Fun
angles.copy: From pumpkin patches to scare-fests, October half-term (Oct 26-30 for many) is packed with family Halloween fun across the UK. What's top of your list?

moments.title: Strictly's Icons Week
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing returns this Saturday for 'Icons Week', where celebrity couples will embody famous figures in their routines.

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Get ready for some iconic moves! Strictly Come Dancing is back this Saturday with 'Icons Week'. Who are you hoping the couples embody on the dancefloor? #Strictly

angles.name: New Hosts
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are leading the glitterball charge this year! What do you think of the new Strictly hosting trio as 'Icons Week' approaches?

moments.title: Nigella Lawson Joins Bake Off
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off continues, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge this series.

angles.name: New Judge
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent! The Great British Bake Off continues tonight on Channel 4. Are you enjoying Nigella as the new judge alongside Paul Hollywood?

angles.name: Baking Craze
angles.copy: What's your favourite bakes to watch on The Great British Bake Off? Nigella Lawson joining the judging panel has certainly spiced things up! Catch it tonight on Channel 4.

moments.title: Premier League Weekend Action
moments.blurb: The Premier League returns this weekend with a full slate of fixtures, including Everton vs Chelsea and Leeds vs Man Utd.

angles.name: Weekend Kick-off
angles.copy: Premier League is back! This weekend sees some big clashes, including Everton vs Chelsea and Leeds vs Man Utd. Who are you backing to win? #PremierLeague

angles.name: Match Focus
angles.copy: Saturday highlights: Brentford vs Liverpool and Man City vs Ipswich. Sunday brings Nottingham Forest vs Arsenal. Get ready for a weekend of top-flight football!

angles.name: Celebration
angles.copy: Yeah! Usher turns 48 today. From 'U Remind Me' to 'OMG', what's your favourite track from the R&B icon? 🎉

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon
angles.copy: The Real Slim Shady turns 54 on October 17! Happy Birthday to the one and only Eminem. What's his most iconic track for you?

angles.name: Legendary Rapper

angles.name: Pop Sensation
angles.copy: Say So! Doja Cat turns 31 on October 21. What's your favourite genre-bending hit from the pop superstar?

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: A true rock legend! Bill Wyman, the iconic former bassist for The Rolling Stones, celebrates his 90th birthday on October 24. What's your favourite Stones track featuring his bass lines?

moments.title: National Album Day: Icons
moments.blurb: National Album Day is on October 17, celebrating 'Icons' with special reissues and new releases, including works from The Beatles and The Who.

angles.name: Album Icons
angles.copy: National Album Day is this Saturday, October 17, celebrating 'Icons'! Which iconic album would you recommend everyone listen to today?

angles.name: New & Reissued
angles.copy: From The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' box set to new releases from Tinie Tempah, National Album Day (Oct 17) is packed with treats for music lovers. What are you adding to your collection?

moments.title: Cardiff Halloween Frights
moments.blurb: Cardiff is gearing up for Halloween with events like 'Harvest of Horror' at Clearwell Farm and '80s Fright Night' at Techniquest.

angles.name: Cardiff Spooks
angles.copy: Cardiff is getting spooky! From 'Harvest of Horror' to '80s Fright Night' at Techniquest, there are plenty of Halloween events around. What are your plans?

angles.name: Local Thrills
angles.copy: Looking for Halloween thrills in Cardiff? Bingo Lingo Halloween and themed club nights are coming up. Get your costumes ready!

moments.title: Swansea's Day of the Dead Halloween
moments.blurb: Swansea's free 'Spooks in the City' Halloween event on October 31 will have a 'Day of the Dead' theme, with mariachi bands and fire performers.

angles.name: Day of the Dead
angles.copy: Swansea's 'Spooks in the City' on Oct 31 is going 'Day of the Dead' this year! Expect mariachi bands, fire performers, and sugar skull decorating. Sounds amazing!

angles.name: Family Fun
angles.copy: Free Halloween fun in Swansea! 'Spooks in the City' at St David's Place on Oct 31 promises Latin American dance, face painting, and crafts. Perfect for the whole family!

moments.title: Devon & Exeter Halloween Events
moments.blurb: Devon and Exeter have a host of Halloween events starting, including Crealy Spook-Fest, Kents Cavern Ghost Walks, and various parties.

angles.name: Devon Spooky Season
angles.copy: Devon is getting ready for Halloween! Crealy Spook-Fest runs this weekend and next, plus Kents Cavern Ghost Walks are on until Oct 31. What are your local spooky plans?

angles.name: Exeter Frights
angles.copy: Exeter's Halloween calendar is filling up! From silent discos at RAM Museum to parties at Fever Exeter, there are plenty of ways to get your fright on. What's catching your eye?
